Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 29.89 per unit (po:4500014436-10, po:4500014383-10, po:4500014337-10).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your data; however, our pricing reflects current manufacturing realities for this specialized component. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We accept your proposed volume of 23,400 units, the 56-day lead time, and the 36-month contract duration. Based on these extended commitments, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.70 per unit. 

For clarity, our Angebot comprises a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner

decisions.tactician: E0 is the only selectable option; every other mix is unpriced. It meets the must-have volume and offers the long binding commitment and relaxed lead time the supplier explicitly values. Its price sits near our health level, which helps avoid the relationship charge. The cited arguments anchor price on cost, past orders and its weak OTD. a3 is left out because flagging rising demand could weaken our position with a capacity-short supplier.

decisions.tactician: E0 keeps the terms the supplier has already accepted, which meet its need for firm long-term commitment. It lowers our C by about €58k versus accepting offer:70410-1. Its status is open and its concessions are steady, so accepting now would leave value on the table. No other option is selectable because the alternative term trades are unpriced. The forecast increase (a1) is a new argument kind that strengthens the commitment value without revealing urgency.
